newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Banco Ganadero raised.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Banco Ganadero raised.

text.p: -- Morgan Stanley said it upgraded Banco Ganadero SA to strong buy from outperform
-- It also said it cut Banco de Bogota SA to neutral from outperform on price
-- Morgan Stanley analysts Rafael Bello and Yovanka Bylander said in a research note they were leaving their 12-month price target of $29 per preferred ADR for Banco Ganadero.
-- "Our price target of $29/ADR leaves an upside potential of 27 percent over the next 12 months," the note said.
-- The analysts said they viewed the bank as a winner in the new competitive environment, citing its strong capital base and "clear strategic objectives".
-- Banco Ganadero's preferred ADRs were up 1-1/4 to 23-3/4 in the afternoon.
-- The analysts said they were downgrading Banco de Bogot because while they still like the bank's fundamentals, they believed these were already reflected in its stock price.
-- They also said they believed the bank was not aggressive enough in the current environment.
-- They set 1997 earnings per share estimates of $0.39 versus prior estimates of $0.69 and 1998 estimates of $0.46 versus $0.80.
-- Banco de Bogot was up 120 Colombian pesos at 6,660 today.
